title: Robotic Garage
content: It’s been a while but I had a reoccurring dream where I would be driving at night and have a flat tire and looking for a garage. Irl, I can change a tire, no problem but for some reason, I can’t in dream world. When I’m looking all around there are many garages that are closed or closing and don’t want to help. There’s always one though at the end of the strip and it’s still open so I go there. The guy at the front is nice but robotic in his movements so I go and sit in the waiting room. After a really long wait, I go to see what the workers are doing and they are frozen in place like their batteries ran out on them. I go to the front desk and the same guy is still there in the dark, unblinking and smiling. He repeats a phrase a few times and his batteries run out and I’m left in the dark.
